Location: Dublin
Description:

A Captain is sought for a permanent position commanding a Class B passenger vessel operating in Dublin Bay. The role requires a STCW Master 500GT Near Coastal Certificate of Competency and proven leadership experience, ideally within passenger or near coastal operations. Responsibilities include ensuring safe navigation, leading the onboard team, managing daily operations, and upholding safety standards. Accommodation is provided in Dublin.
